description: Allocation bucket 1235 is above the 1234.5 threshold, so the targeted delivery rule is skipped with the exclusion reason and the flag serves its default. This is the case a port that ignores the allocation on targeted delivery fails (it serves the rule).

probe.why: Half a bucket above the same fractional targeted delivery threshold.

reasons: rule "rule_td_alloc" excluded by traffic allocation (hash 1235 >= threshold 1234.5)
no rules matched, returning default variation
